question:
What would be the Roman numeral on the opposite side of 'VI' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5065819716be7ae8eaedf35e1882f37be22bfeb1ddb4233df2754c24219bfbae.png]
solution:
From the given open dice

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4871f0bbdddcf0cc92b49d0b6b4d54c140c432a90ffec621aa47a31525e5107c.png] 

**VIII is the opposite side of VI**

IX is the opposite side of X

V is the opposite side of VII

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
